title: A Prom for the Recipe
author: V. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ines Zhou, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
